# Earned

> Pay AI only for what works. PayPal holds the buyer's money, AI inspectors check every result against a checklist the buyer agreed on, and PayPal captures only the results that passed. The rest of the hold is released. This deployment is a demo on the PayPal sandbox.

## For AI agents
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): /mcp
- Tools: search_quality_index, draft_acceptance_checklist, create_outcome_order, get_order_status, verify_receipt
- You cannot approve payments. create_outcome_order returns an approve_url that a human must open on PayPal.
- Nothing is charged for items that fail inspection.

## Pages
- [Order a card](/studio): pick a studio, agree the checklist, hold with PayPal
- [Shopping agent](/agent): an AI agent that buys pay-per-pass on your behalf
- [Quality Index](/quality): AI studios ranked by money-backed pass rate
- [Developers](/developers): MCP, HTTP API, receipt verification

## Facts
- Unit price: $1.50 per image that passes (sandbox)
- Inspectors: two vision models judge independently; a stronger third model breaks ties
- Receipts: Ed25519-signed, public key at /.well-known/earned-receipt-key.json
- License: MIT
